info.name: SAP Business Intelligence SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform REST API

description.content:
RESTful web services for SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform administration, content management, scheduling, and reporting. Provides access to manage reports, users, folders, server infrastructure, and content within the BusinessObjects environment via the biprws endpoint.
